title: Recurring Courses of Care in Progress — Visits Already Given
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the visits already given on a course in progress are added to the qualifying medical debt Riverbend documents for its own charges.

- **Course in progress**: the patient's issued Good Faith & Price Estimates self-pay good faith estimate for a recurring course of care (the estimate listed first when several are issued) whose scheduled first visit is on or before the documentation day.
- **Course account's unbilled charges**: the charges posted on the course's linked Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account less that account's self-pay final-bill liabilities.

| Linked account coding | Added |
|---|---|
| emergency or medically necessary | the program's amounts-generally-billed percentage (34.6 percent on every tier) of its unbilled charges, rounded half-up to the cent |
| elective | its unbilled charges less its account type's elective uninsured discount percent of them (the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) schedule's figure for that account type), the discount rounded half-up to the cent |
| otherwise, including no first visit scheduled or none come | nothing |

**Boundary of the first visit (hypothetical).** A first visit scheduled on the documentation day itself counts as come; one scheduled for the day after does not, and nothing is added.

**Hypothetical figures.** Charges posted 1,000.00, no final-bill liability, medically necessary: 346.00 is added.
